base_design: hero broadleaf tree: flared roots, curved trunk, 5 limbs, leaf-sprig card canopy
purpose: replaces faceted low-poly canopy blobs seen in Postcard Ancient woodland and meadow scenes (visual gap: evidence/scenes/woodland-daylight-phone.png)
creator: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (procedural Blender 5.2.2 + numpy), 20 Oct 2026
licence: Original procedural work created locally; no external assets, no paid generation, no licensed inputs. Rights follow the project's own assets policy (owner: Alexandre Nielsen's project).
textures: procedural, generated by build script: tileable bark albedo+normal (FFT noise, vertical streaks, moss patches), leaf-sprig RGBA atlas (alpha-masked). JPEG for bark, PNG for leaf alpha.

variant_status.distance: needs review (leaf cards resized 20 Oct 2026; reads as a tree at distance)
variant_status.high_gold: needs review (autumn colourway, generated 20 Oct 2026 for the v4 Autumn lake)
variant_status.mobile_gold: needs review (autumn colourway, generated 20 Oct 2026 for the v4 Autumn lake)
variant_status.high_crimson: needs review (autumn colourway, generated 20 Oct 2026 for the v4 Autumn lake)
variant_status.mobile_crimson: needs review (autumn colourway, generated 20 Oct 2026 for the v4 Autumn lake)

orientation: glTF Y-up, metres, origin at ground-level trunk centre; root tips are buried ~0.28 m below origin on purpose (no floating).

materials.Leaf_Mat: Principled, base colour sprig x vertex-colour AO, alphaMode MASK cutoff .5, doubleSided (patched into the GLB after export)

collision_guidance.canopy: non-solid (walk under: lowest foliage ~3.2 m); camera should avoid being inside canopy bounds sphere radius ~5.2 m centred (0,0,6.0) unless intentional

limits: Not rigged/animated; sway should be a shader/vertex-wind in the engine (leaf cards share one sprig tile, so wind by card pivot is an adapter task)
Bark reads as fine streaks more than deep fissures at <1 m; needs review
Foliage shows tile repetition on close inspection; single sprig atlas
Not tested inside the Postcard (Three.js) yet: only Blender re-import + Eevee renders
No device testing; texture memory is computed (RGBA + mip estimate), not measured on a GPU
REQUIRES adapters/foliage-normals.js (or equivalent): alpha-masked canopy cards otherwise show black undersides in Three.js because of back-face normal flipping
Run tools/fix_sidedness.py and tools/refresh_hashes.py after any rebuild; Blender's exporter otherwise ships opaque materials double-sided
Distance variant: 120 cards x 2.1 m, checked in Blender only

Autumn colourways (gold, crimson) share the green tree's geometry and generator (`build_tree_hero.py -- <tier> <dir> <gold|crimson>`); only the leaf atlas differs. Used in living-postcard-mobile-v4 'Autumn lake' (mobile tier).

three_js_import.browser: headless Chrome, software GL (emulation, not a device)
three_js_import.result: all variants parse; textures decode; no loader errors or warnings
three_js_import.evidence: evidence/three-import/*.png (daylight, dusk; *_adapted where the foliage adapter applies)

engine_checks.winding_vs_normals: checked with tools/winding_check.py; tube/shell inversions found and fixed in the generators on 20 Oct 2026 (trunks, branches, pine trunk, kelp stalk, staghorn, fan stem, turtle shell). Remaining intentional: double-sided cards with fixed normals (fins, kelp blades) and thin flippers
engine_checks.sidedness: opaque materials exported single-sided via tools/fix_sidedness.py (run after every rebuild); alpha-masked cards and creature files stay double-sided
engine_checks.adapter: REQUIRES adapters/foliage-normals.js (or equivalent): alpha-masked canopy cards otherwise show black undersides in Three.js because of back-face normal flipping
